SASBDB entry SASDN32  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDN32/)

Publication: Sas20 is a highly flexible starch-binding protein in the Ruminococcus bromii cell-surface amylosome
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2022.101896

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDN32/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
